Experiment_Info.query: Find the sink in the bathroom

Step_1.description: The robot is in a room with a blue wooden ceiling and floor, a large window with white curtains, and a dark purple sofa. A closed blue door is visible on the left. This appears to be a living room, not a bathroom.

Step_2.description: The robot is in a kitchen area, with a refrigerator, stove, and range hood visible. A closed blue double door is on the right side of the view. No open door is visible.

Step_3.description: The robot is in a kitchen area, facing a sink, dishwasher, and dining table. No doors are visible.

Step_4.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to a room with a checkered floor. A kitchen counter is on the right. Moving forward to get a clearer view of the room beyond the door.

Step_5.description: An open doorway is visible on the left leading to a room with a checkered floor. On the right, there is a counter with patterned tiles, suggesting a kitchen area. Moving forward to get a clearer view of the room beyond the door.

Step_6.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to a room with a black and white checkered floor. A closed white cabinet is in the center, and a counter with a patterned backsplash is on the right. The room beyond the door is identified as 'living room & kitchen', which is connected to the goal room 'bathroom'.

Step_7.description: The robot is facing a wall with a closed white cabinet. An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to a room with a checkered floor. A counter is on the right. The door is visible on the left and is not yet close or centered, so the robot moves forward to approach it.

Step_8.description: The robot is facing a grey wall with a closed white double-door cabinet in the center. An open doorway leading to a room with a black and white checkered floor is visible on the left. The current room has a blue wooden floor. The open door is off-center and not yet close.

Step_9.description: The robot is facing a closed, light-colored double door or closet that is centered and fills most of the view, with the top slightly cropped. The floor is dark. The robot is aligned and close to the door, preparing to transition to the next state.

Step_10.description: A closed white double door with two handles is centered in the view. The door is not open, preventing passage.

Step_11.description: The robot is facing a white two-panel door with two round handles, which is centered and appears close, filling most of the camera's view. The top and bottom edges of the door are slightly cropped.

Step_12.description: The robot is facing a closed white double door with two round handles, centered in the view. A grey wall is visible on the left.

Step_13.description: The robot is facing a closed white double door with two handles, which is centered in the view. A grey wall is visible on the left. Following the policy rules for 'Oriented Towards Door', the robot will move forward as the door is centered and not yet close, despite it being closed.

Step_14.description: The robot is facing a closed white door with two round handles, which is very close and fills most of the frame. A grey wall is visible on the left, indicating the door is slightly to the right, requiring a lateral adjustment.

Step_15.description: The robot is facing a closed, light-colored double door with two circular knobs, centered in the frame. The door is visible but not yet close enough to transition to the next state.

Step_16.description: The robot is facing a closed white door with two doorknobs, which fills the entire camera view. The robot is very close to the door.

Step_17.description: The robot is facing a closed door with a doorknob on the right side, centered in the view. The door is not open, preventing passage.

Step_18.description: The robot is very close to a light-colored surface with a dark vertical line slightly to the left, indicating a door opening to the left.
